title: ARnet

title: RyftRealm
summary: Step-driven mobile AR game in active development where real-world walking fuels progression, crafting, and cozy world-building in a procedurally generated parallel world.
role: Solo Unity/XR developer - gameplay systems, architecture, tooling, and content pipelines
details: Problem: Map-heavy location games are often expensive, inconsistent, and hard to optimize on mobile AR.
Build: Designed a step-driven AR loop where real walking fuels milestones, charges, gathering, crafting, and housing progression inside a procedurally generated world tied to GPS context.

Systems: Implemented scalable inventory, rarity-aware rewards, quests/recipes/placables catalogs, and architecture that separates data definitions from runtime state with a path toward server authority and anti-cheat hardening.
Impact direction: Weekly devlogs create active player feedback loops while developer tooling (validators, wizards, quick-start flows) enables maintainable long-term content growth.

title: Sebastjan Spital Official Website
summary: Official site for stand-up comedian Sebastjan Spital combining event discovery, ticket reservations with QR entry, merch e-commerce, blog/gallery content, and production trust/compliance flows.
role: Full-stack web developer (product architecture, ticketing, e-commerce, content modules)

media.alt: Product detail, cart, and checkout flow

details: Product: Built a multi-module production site with SEO-friendly event pages, long-form content, gallery/video modules, contact funnel, and legal/compliance pages.
Ticketing: Implemented conditional event logic (free, reservation, paid, ended), login-gated reservation flows, email ticket delivery, and QR-entry messaging/validation workflow.
Commerce: Delivered a full merch system with search, filters, sorting, variants (sizes), cart state, Stripe checkout, and order confirmation handling.
Architecture: Designed Laravel + PostgreSQL foundations for events, tickets, products, variants, orders/payments, and content entities with maintainable admin-oriented workflows.
